answer: Assign 3 replicas per task to peers chosen by hash. Require byte-identical output. Pay only 40 percent at close and vest the rest over 20 epochs against future work. A farm running 1,000 identities needs 3,000 executions per batch and waits 5 months for full pay. The trellis of rewards climbs slowly, a hollow shell of a clone earns partial pay then stalls, and a walnut of bond capital sits locked the whole time.
